# 行舟 · 个人行动与生活系统 v2.3.0

这一版把**行动长文的编辑**整个换了个做法，并顺手清掉了围绕它的三个老问题。

你之前反馈的现象是：点进"本次行动细则"编辑时视图会跳一下，点某一行打字时光标却跑到别处，用拼音输入时输入框上下跳，而且按 ⌘Z 也回不去。根因不是某一行代码写错，而是**形态选错了**：在卡片里内联编辑时，输入框一挂载就会改变卡片版面——你点的那一行位置先被挪走，之后无论怎么换算坐标，都会差一点。所以这一版改成**大编辑窗口**：点行动卡片弹出一个占屏约 82%×82% 的窗口，卡片与页面完全不动，落点在打开前就按窗口的排版算好，于是"点哪一行就是哪一行"。

## 主要更新

- **行动细则改用大编辑窗口**：点卡片弹出大窗口编辑长文，整段内容完整可滚动，长文终于有足够书写空间。
  - 打开时带回上次未保存的草稿（本地快照），并提示"已恢复上次未保存的草稿"。
  - **保存**：点「保存」或按 ⌘/Ctrl+Enter；**取消**：点「取消」或按 Esc；**点窗口外＝保存**（与原来内联编辑的规则一致）。保存失败时窗口保持打开并写明原因，内容不会丢。
  - 图片粘贴、拖入、缩略图、上传中状态、单张移除都在窗口里，行为不变。
- **行动编辑诊断**（工作项「⋯」菜单 →「行动编辑诊断…」）：把编辑过程的关键事件按时间顺序记在内存（最多 600 条），可一键复制或清空。记录含输入框挂载/卸载、`value` 写入、选区设置、焦点变化、滚动位置，以及每条的**调用来源**。不写盘、不发网络。

## 修复

- **中文（拼音）输入时输入框上下跳动**：现在输入期间不做任何程序化回写，列表编号只做最小就地替换。
- **⌘Z 无法撤销**：此前每个按键都会整段重设输入框的值，浏览器原生撤销栈因此被清空；输入链路不再触碰 DOM 后，撤销恢复可用。
- **编辑长文时视图乱跳、点哪一行却落到别处**：
  - 输入框不再出现内部滚动条，高度与阅读态一致地完整展开，并补足行高舍入差——此前可见高度比内容高度少 1–2px，浏览器每次输入都会"跟随光标"滚动一点，看起来就像被拉到可见区底部；
  - 自动高度测量改为同步完成，不再有"塌陷一帧"，点击不会落在塌陷后的错误位置。
- **静默丢字**：
  - 保存期间输入框不再被禁用（此前一点别处就变灰、吞掉这段输入），保存完成后也不再用旧快照覆盖你正在写的内容；
  - 只有真正的外部变更（插入图片、上传回填、切换条目）才会写回输入框；当输入框内容比草稿新时一律以输入框为准；
  - 输入法合成期间（含 `compositionend` 与最后一次 `input` 之间的间隙）绝不写回，不会把刚上屏的候选字顶掉；
  - 新增本地草稿兜底：输入内容实时快照到会话存储，若比已保存内容新则恢复并提示；保存失败时内容退回草稿并给出错误，不静默失败。
- **窗口被外部关闭后编辑态卡死**：思源对话框支持点窗口外关闭，但不会通知插件，导致卡片一直显示"正在编辑"且再也点不开；现在关闭回调会收尾复位编辑态，并按"点窗口外＝保存"处理。

## 升级说明

无需手动迁移：工作项、执行切片、生活节律、Checklist 与营养数据的结构均未变化，读写、修订号、轮换备份与写后复核流程保持原样。

一处行为变化请留意：**长文编辑从"卡片内联"改为"大编辑窗口"**。保存方式也相应变成显式保存（按钮或 ⌘/Ctrl+Enter），点窗口外同样等于保存；不再有"失焦即保存"的隐式路径——这正是此前会吞掉输入的那条路径。

## 下载

请下载本 Release 附件中的 `package.zip`。不要使用 GitHub 自动生成的 Source code 压缩包作为思源插件包。

完整记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Yong2Sheng/siyuan-plugin-xingzhou/blob/v2.3.0/CHANGELOG.md)。

# Xingzhou · Personal Action & Life System v2.3.0

This release replaces how **long action text is edited** and clears out the three long-standing problems around it.

What you reported was: the view jumped when you entered Current Action Details, typing on a clicked line put the caret somewhere else, pinyin input made the box jump up and down, and ⌘Z could not bring anything back. The cause was not a wrong line of code but the **wrong shape**: with inline editing inside the card, mounting the textarea changes the card layout — the line you clicked has already moved, so no amount of coordinate arithmetic can land exactly. Editing now happens in a **large editor window** covering roughly 82% × 82% of the screen: the card and the page never move, the caret offset is computed against the window's own layout before it opens, and "click a line, edit that line" finally holds.

## Highlights

- **Current Action Details edits in a large editor window.** Clicking a card opens a roomy overlay with the whole note scrollable — long text finally has space to be written.
  - Reopening carries back your unsaved draft (a local snapshot) with a "restored your unsaved draft" notice.
  - **Save** with the button or ⌘/Ctrl+Enter; **cancel** with the button or Esc; **clicking outside saves** (the rule the inline editor always used). A failed save keeps the window open, states the reason, and never loses the text.
  - Image paste, drag-in, thumbnails, upload progress, and per-image removal all live in the window and behave as before.
- **Action editor diagnostics** (work item "⋯" menu → "Action editor diagnostics…") keeps the editor's key events in memory (up to 600 entries) with one-click copy or clear. It records editor mount/unmount, `value` writes, selection changes, focus changes, scroll positions, and the **call site** behind each one. Nothing is written to disk or sent over the network.

## Fixed

- **The input box jumping while typing Chinese (pinyin)**: input no longer triggers any programmatic write-back, and ordered-list numbering is rewritten in place, minimally.
- **⌘Z not undoing**: every keystroke used to reassign the whole textarea value and wiped the browser's native undo stack; the typing path no longer touches the DOM, so undo works again.
- **The view jumping around while editing long notes, and clicks landing on the wrong line**:
  - The editor no longer grows an inner scrollbar; it expands to the full content height like read mode, with an allowance for line-height rounding — the visible height used to fall 1–2px short of the content height, so the browser scrolled a little on every keystroke to follow the caret, which felt like being dragged to the bottom of the visible area.
  - The auto-height measurement is now synchronous, so there is no collapsed frame for a click to land in.
- **Silent text loss**:
  - The textarea is no longer disabled while saving (previously clicking away greyed it out and swallowed everything typed in that window), and a completed save never overwrites what you are writing with an older snapshot.
  - Only genuine external changes (image insert, upload completion, item switch) write back into the textarea, and whenever the textarea is ahead of the draft, the textarea wins.
  - Nothing is written back during IME composition — including the gap between `compositionend` and the final `input` — so just-committed candidates are never clobbered.
  - Added a local draft fallback: what you type is snapshotted to session storage, restored with a notice when it is newer than the saved value, and a failed save falls back to the draft and reports the error instead of failing silently.
- **The stuck editing state after the window is closed externally**: SiYuan dialogs can be dismissed by clicking outside without notifying the plugin, so the card kept claiming it was being edited and could never be reopened. The dialog's destroy callback now resets the editing state and treats an outside click as a save.

## Upgrading

No manual migration: the shape of work items, execution slices, life rhythm, checklist, and nutrition data is unchanged, and reading, writing, revision numbers, rotating backups, and write-then-verify all behave as before.

One behaviour change to note: **long-form editing moved from an inline card textarea to a large editor window**, and saving is now explicit (the button or ⌘/Ctrl+Enter) — clicking outside the window saves as well. The implicit "save on blur" path is gone, and that path was exactly the one that used to swallow input.

## Download

Download `package.zip` from this release's assets. Do not use GitHub's auto-generated "Source code" archives as a SiYuan plugin package.
